# Frontend Visual QA

Use this compact packet for material UI changes or focused visual defects.

## Surface

- Route/screen:
- Changed component(s):
- Theme(s):
- Viewports/devices:
- Primary state/flow:

## Visual sanity

- [ ] Text/icon/background contrast is readable in every affected theme/state.
- [ ] Related edges, labels, controls and repeated items align as intended.
- [ ] Spacing follows the existing token/scale; no accidental one-off gaps.
- [ ] No unintended horizontal overflow.
- [ ] No clipped/truncated text unless explicitly designed.
- [ ] No accidental overlap, hidden controls or z-index obstruction.
- [ ] Long/localized text and realistic content do not break the layout.
- [ ] Hover/focus/disabled/error/open states remain visually coherent.
- [ ] Mobile and desktop remain usable; tablet/print/Safari included when project-critical.

## Evidence

- Before screenshot/reference:
- After desktop screenshot:
- After mobile screenshot:
- Automated accessibility/contrast result:
- Console/network result:
- Geometry/computed-style evidence for any disputed defect:

## Remaining exceptions

Document intentional truncation, overflow, overlap or contrast exceptions with rationale. Do not silently accept them.
